title: Portfolio Performance Quote Failure Rate
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), recurring-subscription and bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=portfolio:quote
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(quote_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by ticker
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Portfolio Performance quote records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each ticker.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize quote_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per ticker.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It will show which parts of your Portfolio Performance quote data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
